rule: P137 experiment held-out labels: a session that changes the skill, converter or runtime (the drafting-arm build session included) must not read this file, LABELS-P137.md or the templates until a round promotes them (EXCLUSIONS.md)
by: the round-6 held-out draw session, from each template's JSON (name, description, nodes, parameters, connections) and PLAN.md decisions, before running the analyzer on these templates
selection: splits.json experiments p137: 20 candidates of the round-6 walk that round 6 does not draw, selected by P137's rule at convertCommit, all eligible by the round-4 rule with amendment 1 (so outcome subscription by the analyzer) by construction
convention: as labels-held5.json: outcome under the PLAN's default for each question the file cannot settle; questions = kinds whose answer can change the outcome; mayAsk = fine to ask, outcome unchanged; uncertain = where a convention, not the file, decides the label
priorExposure: The selection rule's verdict is known for every template here: the converter at b9d706a blocks at least one step, every blocked step is an app with no REST request template or a connector operation with no tool map, and no vector, database or media step is blocked. Which steps and kinds were not printed before labelling. No analyzer outcome, target, question or eligibility reason for these 20 was on screen; their corpus.json entries were not opened. splits.json shows each template's wake-up kind and source. The question kinds, target rules and surfaces come from reading analyze.mjs's source and capabilities.json, not from any output for these templates

labels.why: Every 5 minutes (minutes rule, n8n's default interval) → HubSpot companies created or updated in the last 5 minutes → filter annual revenue over $5M → Slack message to a fixed user. More often than hourly but not under a minute: a local task
labels.uncertain: the 5-minute interval is n8n's default for a minutes rule, not written in the file

labels.why: Cron daily at 02:00 (no workflow timezone) → Notion list databases → list each database's pages → Function flags pages with empty properties → per page (SplitInBatches of 1): Notion list blocks → Function marks empty pages → If → Notion archive page. Daily fits a cloud task; the time of day needs the timezone
labels.uncertain: the legacy Function and Cron nodes; the loop returns to SplitInBatches from Process Blocks

labels.why: Daily at 09:00 (no workflow timezone) → Set today's date parts → HTTP GET gocomics.com's comic page for the date (fixed host) → Information Extractor (OpenAI) pulls the image URL → OpenAI image analysis (a model step) translates the dialogue → Discord webhook post. labels.uncertain: a one-node example with no description beyond a screenshot; kept as a working read, not a demo of n8n
